Because of this, I formed a small team with my juniors and identified someone who could continue the fellowship with the dedication it deserves.

She is a media student and her work is closely related to social media and content, so I believe she will be able to manage the page more consistently and help in taking the Under25 iLead community forward.

My decision to hand over the fellow title is only because I believe the role requires consistent attention, and at this point she can give that time better than me. However, this does not mean that I want to leave Under25. I truly value this community and would always love to stay connected.
